About the Event:
Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Technology (MGIT), Hyderabad, is organizing theInternal Hackathon for Smart India Hackathon (SIH) 2026on12 September 2026.
TheSmart India Hackathon (SIH) 2026 Problem Statementshave been officially released.Interested students are invited to form eligible teams, carefully review the available problem statements,and select a suitable challenge based on their technical skills, domain knowledge, and ability to developan innovative and practically feasible solution.
Participating teams are expected to thoroughly understand their selected problem statement and preparethesolution idea, proposed methodology, system architecture, technology stack, innovation,feasibility, and prototype.
Teams must prepare their presentation using the officialSIH 2026 Idea Presentation PPT format.The quality of the idea, innovation, technical approach, feasibility, prototype, and presentation will beimportant for further participation inSmart India Hackathon 2026.
Venue:Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Technology (MGIT), Hyderabad
Event Guidelines:
- Each team must consist of6 members, includingat least one female member.
- All team members must becurrent students of MGIT.
- A student can be part ofonly one team. Duplicate participation may lead to disqualification.
- Teams must carefully finalize theirTeam Name. Once submitted, the Team Name cannot be changed.
- Only theTeam Leadershould submit the registration form on behalf of the complete team.
- Correctroll numbers, institute email IDs, and mobile numbersof all team members must be entered.
- Teams must carefully review the officially releasedSIH 2026 Problem Statementsbefore making their selection.
- The selected problem statement should match the team’stechnical skills, domain knowledge, and ability to develop a practical solution.
- Teams must verify theProblem Statement ID (PS ID), Problem Statement Title, Organization,Category, and Themebefore finalizing their selection.
- Teams should thoroughly understand the selected problem statement and prepare thesolution idea, proposed methodology, system architecture, technology stack, innovation,feasibility, and prototype.
- The presentation must be prepared using theofficial SIH 2026 Idea Presentation PPT format.
- The prescribed PPT structure should be followed without unnecessary changes.
- The presentation should beclear, technical, innovative, and focused on the selected problem statement.
- Students must use theirMGIT college email IDwhile submitting the team registration form.
Target Audience:
Current students of Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Technology (MGIT) interested in participating inSmart India Hackathon (SIH) 2026.
Learning Outcomes / Course Outcomes:
- Develop innovative and practical solutions to real-world problem statements.
- Enhance problem-solving, critical-thinking, and technical design skills.
- Apply domain knowledge and appropriate technologies to develop feasible solutions.
- Gain practical experience in methodology development, system architecture, technology selection, and prototyping.
- Strengthen teamwork, innovation, technical presentation, and communication skills.
- Prepare students for further participation inSmart India Hackathon 2026.
